facebook.caption:
This place fixes the mid-trip crash.

Cà Phê Bàng on Đ. Trần Phú is the kind of coffee shop you sit in for two hours without noticing. 4.4 stars. 232 reviews. The crowd is calm, the coffee is real, and nobody is rushing you out.

Phu Quoc moves fast. This spot doesn't.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
